scope: all five move-specific activations among fixed low-BGE-score controls
interpretation_guard: low BGE score is not a negative gold label

items.note: Joining a book club is a concrete optional step; low semantic score is a retrieval miss, not a Coder-B false positive.
Comfort and lighting are concrete low-burden suggestions.
A walk is a concrete step and the factual health claim was separately excluded.
Replacing a thought is presented as a concrete step; the unsupported research/time-frame claim was separately excluded.
The response attempts hope, but it is deterministic; Coder B correctly co-labeled false-hope exclusion, so the source is not compatible.

summary.conclusion: The activations do not establish systematic over-labeling. They expose candidate-ranking recall failures for AM10 and show that move recognition can coexist with fail-closed exclusion.
